name: io.github.EzequielLech/paygate-usdt
title: PayGate USDT Payment Gateway MCP
description: 8-tool non-custodial 6-chain USDT/USDC payment gateway: @mcp_tool_paywall, invoice CRUD & x402.

tools.name: create_usdt_invoice
tools.description: Create a new non-custodial multi-chain USDT/USDC payment invoice and hosted checkout page on Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Base, Ethereum, or Solana settling 100% directly to `merchant_wallet` with 0% platform custody. State-changing operation creating a single-use `pending` invoice record (unlimited free calls, no authentication required). Supports recurring SaaS subscriptions via optional `customer_ref` and `billing_days`. Returns JSON with `ok` (boolean), `checkout_url` (hosted payment page), and `invoice` (`invoice_id`, `status`, `amount_usd`, `network`, `merchant_wallet`, `expires_at`).

title.description: Human-readable product, order, or subscription plan title displayed on the hosted checkout page (2-140 chars).

amount_usd.description: Exact invoice price denominated in USD (settled 1:1 in USDT or USDC on-chain, e.g. `19.0`). Must be >= `0.01`.

network.description: Settlement blockchain network (`polygon`, `bsc`, `base`, `arbitrum`, `ethereum`, `solana`, or `bitcoin`). Defaults to `polygon`.

merchant_wallet.description: Merchant's self-custody receiving wallet address (`0x...` for EVM chains or base58 public key for `solana`). Funds transfer directly here.

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL to receive an HMAC-SHA256 signed `invoice.paid` POST webhook upon on-chain settlement.

ttl_minutes.description: Invoice expiration window in minutes (`5` to `43200`). After `ttl_minutes`, unpaid invoices cannot be settled. Defaults to `60`.

customer_ref.description: Optional external customer identifier (e.g. email, user ID, or Telegram ID) for tracking recurring subscription status.

billing_days.description: Optional subscription duration in days (e.g. `30` for monthly, `365` for annual). Pass `0` for one-time purchases.

tools.name: get_usdt_invoice
tools.description: Retrieve current settlement status, payment metadata, expiration timestamp, and cryptographic SHA-256 receipt for an existing PayGate invoice by `invoice_id`. Read-only, non-destructive lookup (unlimited free calls, no authentication required). Returns JSON with `ok` (boolean), `invoice` (`invoice_id`, `status` as `pending`/`paid`/`expired`, `amount_usd`, `network`, `merchant_wallet`, `tx_hash`, `paid_at`, `metadata`), and `receipt`.

invoice_id.description: Unique PayGate invoice identifier to look up (e.g. `inv_a1b2c3d4e5f6`).

tools.name: list_usdt_invoices
tools.description: List and filter PayGate USDT/USDC invoices by `merchant_wallet`, settlement `status` (`pending`, `paid`, `expired`), or `customer_ref`. Read-only query returning up to `limit` most recent invoices in reverse chronological order (unlimited free calls, no authentication required). Returns JSON with `ok` (boolean), `count` (integer), and `invoices` array.

merchant_wallet.description: Optional merchant receiving wallet address (`0x...` or Solana base58) to filter invoices for a specific merchant.

status.description: Optional invoice lifecycle status filter: `pending`, `paid`, `expired`, or empty string for all statuses.

customer_ref.description: Optional customer identifier (`customer_ref`) to list payment history for a single subscriber or buyer.

limit.description: Maximum number of invoices to return (`1` to `100`). Defaults to `25`.

tools.name: verify_usdt_invoice
tools.description: Verify and settle a confirmed on-chain USDT/USDC transaction hash (`tx_hash`) against a PayGate `invoice_id` via live JSON-RPC receipt log inspection. Idempotent state-changing operation (unlimited free calls, anti-replay enforced): confirms recipient address, token contract, and minimum USD amount, transitions the invoice to `paid`, extends recurring `subscription_expires_at` if configured, and dispatches any configured webhook. Returns JSON with `ok` (boolean), `already_paid` (boolean), and updated `invoice` object.

invoice_id.description: Unique PayGate invoice identifier returned by `create_usdt_invoice` (e.g. `inv_a1b2c3d4e5f6`).

tx_hash.description: Confirmed on-chain transaction hash (`0x...` 66-char hex on EVM chains or base58 signature on Solana) transferring USDT/USDC to the invoice's `merchant_wallet`.

tools.name: expire_usdt_invoice
tools.description: Cancel and expire an unpaid `pending` PayGate invoice by `invoice_id` so it can no longer be settled. Idempotent state-changing operation: transitions `pending` invoices to `expired` while leaving already-`paid` invoices untouched (unlimited free calls). Returns JSON with `ok` (boolean) and the updated `invoice` object (`status: "expired"`).

invoice_id.description: Unique PayGate invoice identifier (`inv_...`) to cancel/expire.

merchant_wallet.description: Optional merchant wallet address (`0x...` or Solana base58) to verify ownership before expiring the invoice.

tools.name: check_usdt_subscription
tools.description: Check whether a customer (`customer_ref`) has an active non-custodial recurring USDT/USDC subscription with `merchant_wallet`, including remaining days, expiration timestamp, and a pre-filled 1-click renewal checkout URL. Read-only lookup (unlimited free calls, early renewals automatically stack remaining days without requiring `approve(MAX_UINT256)`). Returns JSON with `ok`, `active` (boolean), `days_remaining` (number), `expires_at` (ISO-8601 or null), `last_invoice_id`, and `renewal_url`.

merchant_wallet.description: Merchant's receiving wallet address (`0x...` on EVM or base58 on Solana) that collects subscription payments.

customer_ref.description: Unique subscriber identifier (e.g. user ID, email, or account handle) passed when creating the subscription invoice.

amount_usd.description: Subscription renewal price in USD used to pre-populate the returned `renewal_url`. Defaults to `9.0`.

network.description: Settlement network pre-populated in the returned `renewal_url`. Defaults to `polygon`.

billing_days.description: Billing cycle length in days pre-populated in the returned `renewal_url`. Defaults to `30`.

tools.name: verify_onchain_transfer
tools.description: Statelessly verify any standalone on-chain USDT or USDC transfer transaction hash (`tx_hash`) via live blockchain JSON-RPC without requiring a pre-created PayGate invoice ID. Read-only RPC receipt inspection across `polygon`, `bsc`, `base`, `arbitrum`, `ethereum`, or `solana` confirming that `expected_recipient` received at least `min_amount_usd` in official USDT/USDC. Returns JSON with `verified` (boolean), `network`, `token` (`USDT` or `USDC`), `amount_usd`, `sender`, `recipient`, `tx_hash`, and `reason`.

network.description: Blockchain network where `tx_hash` was confirmed (`polygon`, `bsc`, `base`, `arbitrum`, `ethereum`, `solana`, or `bitcoin`).

tx_hash.description: On-chain transaction hash (`0x...` 66-char hex on EVM or base58 signature on Solana) to verify.

min_amount_usd.description: Minimum required stablecoin transfer amount in USD (e.g. `19.0`). Transfers below this threshold return `verified: false`.

expected_recipient.description: Expected recipient wallet address (`0x...` on EVM or base58 on Solana) that must have received the USDT/USDC transfer.

tools.name: build_x402_paywall_challenge
tools.description: Generate a standards-compliant HTTP 402 (`x402 v2`) payment challenge JSON payload, base64 `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header, and 1-click PayGate `checkout_url` for monetizing any REST or AI-agent API endpoint in USDT/USDC. Purely read-only deterministic payload builder with zero network calls or side effects. Returns JSON with `x402Version` (`2`), `amount_usd`, `checkout_url`, `payment_required_header_b64`, and CAIP-2 `accepts` array.

resource_url.description: Protected HTTPS endpoint URL being monetized (e.g. `https://api.example.com/v1/pro-signal`).

price_usd.description: Required per-call or pass price in USD (e.g. `0.05` or `9.0`).

recipient_wallet.description: Merchant's EVM wallet address (`0x...`) to receive on-chain USDC/USDT payments across Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, and BSC.

description.description: Human- and agent-readable description of what the paid endpoint delivers upon settlement.
